title: Downtown Social - Venue
description:
This is an event space that can be created however you’d like! We do an all inclusive experience that we can add a party bus to and from the event space, give you a DJ for your party, and we also have onsite decor.  Add ons are of course appreciated and the space can be used for everything from Bachelorette Parties to Weddings! 

This place fits up to 85 guests at one time seated - 100 total in the building.
